app.title: Fishingbot
loot.title: Loot table
loot.lede: Fish, weights, perks and area catches. Saving applies everything and restarts the local server for a few seconds.
loot.saved: Loot table saved. Restarting the server to load the new catalogue…
loot.staged: Change staged. Save the loot table to apply it.
loot.issues.none: No blocking issues. Ready to save when you have changes.
loot.issue.normal: Normal rarity odds add up to {total}%. They must total exactly 100%.
loot.issue.empty: {rarity} has no fish. Add at least one.
loot.issue.noweight: {rarity} needs at least one fish with a weight above 0.
loot.issue.zeroWeight: {count} fish in {rarity} have weight 0 and will never drop.
loot.issue.lookalike: “{a}” and “{b}” look like the same name. Rename one.
loot.issue.areaEmpty: {area} needs at least one catch with a weight above 0.
loot.odds.title: Rarity odds
loot.odds.hint: Normal catches must total exactly 100%. Treasury rolls separately.
loot.areas.title: Area loot tables
loot.areas.lede: Each area adds its own catch table on top of the fish table. A catch can come from either. Weights are relative inside the area.
loot.areas.name: Catch name
loot.areas.boostHelp: Boost raises a catch's weight in this area only. 0 means no boost; 1 is +10% of its weight.
loot.areas.resetConfirm: Restore the built-in catches and boosts for {area}? Unsaved changes to this area are lost.
loot.modal.name: Name
loot.modal.weightHelp: Relative chance inside its rarity. 100 is neutral, 200 is twice as likely, 0 never drops.
loot.modal.perkHelp: A perk is a viewer-facing effect that starts when this fish is caught.
loot.modal.perkDescPh: What viewers see, e.g. Brighter odds for a while.
loot.modal.cooldownHelp: Shorter wait between casts while the effect lasts.
loot.modal.timeoutHelp: Times the catcher out. Respects an active timeout shield.
loot.modal.similar: Similar names already in the table: {names}. Check this is not a duplicate.
loot.modal.errName: Enter a name of 1–60 letters, numbers or basic punctuation.
loot.modal.errWeight: Weight must be a number from 0 to 10,000.
loot.modal.errMultiplier: Multiplier must be above 0 and at most 10.
loot.modal.errCooldown: Cooldown reduction must be above 0% and at most 80%.
loot.modal.errDuration: Minutes must be whole numbers from 1 to 20.
loot.modal.deleteConfirm: Remove {name} from the loot table? Its weight and perk go with it.
loot.effect.hint.luck: Raises the odds of rarer catches while the effect lasts.
loot.effect.hint.weight: Raises the weight of every catch in the roll while the effect lasts.
loot.effect.hint.treasuryLuck: Raises the odds of Treasury catches while the effect lasts.
loot.effect.hint.cooldownReduction: Shortens the wait between casts while the effect lasts.
loot.effect.hint.timeout: Applies a timeout to the catcher right away. Nothing lasts after it.
loot.preview.weight: Catching {name} gives {value}× drop weight for {minutes} minutes.
loot.preview.treasuryLuck: Catching {name} gives {value}× Treasury luck for {minutes} minutes.
loot.preview.cooldownReduction: Catching {name} cuts the cooldown by {value}% for {minutes} minutes.
loot.preview.timeout: Catching {name} times the catcher out for {minutes} minutes.
shell.lede: One place for game, viewer, broadcaster and application controls.
ov.connectHint: Connect your account so the bot can answer chat.
ov.updated: Updated {0}. Warns above {1}% CPU or {2} Mbps.
game.s25: Changes save as you make them. Prices use Treasury items; set a price to zero to make it free.
game.s29: The cooldown is global. Auto-Fish availability is set here too.
game.s33: These apply to everyone. Viewers still set their own wording.
game.s36: Short (no luck, area or event extras)
game.s48: Disabling a feature hides it for everyone. Player unlocks and progression are kept.
game.s52: Shop, rod, bait and Pond prices
game.s57: Treasury costs for unlocking each area and upgrading it to levels 2 to 5. The world map uses the same values.
game.s59: Shop, Pond and area prices saved.
